modules.title: Arrive in the moment.
modules.description: Before you begin, give yourself a moment to settle. Let the noise of the day fall away and bring your attention to what you’re here to practice.
modules.focus: Take three slow breaths. Notice how you feel, without needing to change it.

modules.title: Build a steady rhythm.
modules.description: Choose a pace you can sustain. The goal is to stay engaged and present, building consistency one deliberate movement at a time.
modules.focus: Keep your effort comfortable. Check in with your posture and breathing as you go.

modules.title: Notice what changed.
modules.description: Take a few minutes to reflect on the practice. Small observations help turn an ordinary session into something you can learn from.
modules.focus: Name one thing that felt easier, and one thing you want to return to next time.
